strings: r_c0 sympathetically prepares some stomach-pain relieving herbs for m_c to have with {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} prey.
After eating, m_c is left feeling a bit queasy as the prey doesn't sit well within {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} belly.
m_c miserably rolls over onto {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} back, feeling uncomfortable resting on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} belly.
